title: 第7章 瑞云拍卖行第8章 拍卖会始
content_zh:
听到傅心莲的一番话，白月二人虽觉得意外，但也在情理之中。
况且见云风不远前来这墨云斋鉴宝，想来也是对这里十分信任，索性自己也是有求于人，便大方的应下了。
云风见白月这小财迷也没什么意见，也应了下来。
但想到此行的目的，也腆着脸开口了。
“心莲，其实你不必这么客气，我们也不是小气之人，既然你师傅喜欢，你也可以带回去让他老人家开心一下，不过我们也是有一事相求于你。”
“哦？请讲。”
傅心莲听罢也松了一口气，恢复原来的翩翩公子模样道。
“我们兄妹二人自小都是孤儿，居无定所，生活也是吃饱了这一餐，下顿也不知有没有着落的，没见过什么世面，我是想请心莲你帮个忙。”
“其一是能帮我们两个制造一个身份，好让我妹妹能到城里去念书；其二是能不能帮我们搭个线，找个拍卖的地方，帮这些古玩找个好的买主，顺便也换些钱接济一下生活。”
“当然，那个汝窑莲花碗你可带去给你的师傅好好鉴赏，我们也不急着要，毕竟对穷人来说，最主要的还是讨生活不是？”
云风一脸真挚的望着傅心莲，眼神不似有假。
傅心莲虽觉得云风的理由听着倒也情有可原，但是听他说话的内容却总是感觉别扭。
这五件古玩，随便拿一件到拍卖会上都能拍出高价，对一般人来说都可谓是一夜暴富了！这云风竟说换些钱讨生活，真是听着都能气死个人。
不过这些小事对傅心莲来说也只是举手之劳，随即便高兴的应下了。
说是恰巧三日之后，越城的瑞云拍卖行会举行一次大型的拍卖会，这拍卖行竟也是他的产业！
这些拍品他都可以临时加上，只是宣传册早已发出，就当是临时加上的神秘拍品好了，也能添增个噱头，到时候白月云风二人只需拿着请柬去观看就好。
至于身份问题，明日就能搞定，到时送去傅心莲给二人安置的酒店房间即可。
见傅心莲转眼就跟一旁的人交代好一切事宜，效率之快，让白月十分满意，走的路上不停的夸赞负心哥哥十分能干！效率非常！
听得一旁的店员看着自家老板的眼神十分诡异，傅心莲心中暗暗叫苦，巴不得赶紧把这小祖宗赶紧送回酒店待着。
三日后，正在酒店吃晚饭的白月二人收到了傅心莲差人送来的瑞云拍卖行请柬。

这三日间，白月也通过不同的渠道打听到这位负心哥哥的能量与地位。
据说他是京城博物馆馆长墨开霁的得意弟子，也是京城第一豪门傅家第三代的长子，将来很可能会继承家中产业，成为总多名媛争抢的钻石王老五。
还听说这位傅公子尤其钟爱华国古代历史文化，特别是古玩字画一类，平日里都是束发挽簪，焚香吃斋。
content_en:
Hearing what Fu Xinlian said, although Bai Yue and the two felt surprised, it was also reasonable.
Moreover, seeing that Yunfeng had come to Moyunzhai not far away to appraise treasures, he believed in this place very much. He simply had something to ask for, so he agreed generously.
Yunfeng saw that Bai Yue, a little money fan, didn't have any objections, so he agreed.
But thinking about the purpose of this trip, he spoke with a shy face.
"Xinlian, actually you don't have to be so polite. We are not stingy people. Since your master likes it, you can take it back to make him happy, but we also have something to ask of you."
"Oh? Please speak."
After hearing this, Fu Xinlian breathed a sigh of relief and returned to her original appearance of a handsome young man.
"Both of us, brother and sister, have been orphans since we were young. We have no fixed place to live. Our lives are filled with one meal, and we don't know if we will have anything to eat next. We have never seen much of the world. I want to ask Xinlian for a favor."
"The first is to help us create an identity so that my sister can go to the city to study; the second is to help us find a place to auction, find a good buyer for these antiques, and also exchange some money to support our lives."
"Of course, you can take that Ru kiln lotus bowl to your master for appreciation. We are not in a hurry to get it. After all, for the poor, the most important thing is to make a living, right?"
Yunfeng looked at Fu Xinlian sincerely, and his eyes didn't seem to be fake.
Although Fu Xinlian felt that Yunfeng's reasons were understandable, she always felt awkward listening to the content of what he said.
Any one of these five antiques can fetch a high price at an auction. For most people, it can be said that they become rich overnight! This Yunfeng actually said that he could exchange some money to make a living. Hearing this would make a person angry to death.
But these little things were just a piece of cake for Fu Xinlian, and she happily agreed.
It happened that three days later, Ruiyun Auction House in Yuecheng would hold a large-scale auction. This auction house was actually his property!
He can add these auctions temporarily, but the brochure has already been sent out, so just treat them as temporary and mysterious auctions. It can also add a gimmick. When the time comes, Bai Yue Yunfeng and the two of them only need to take the invitation to watch.
As for the identity issue, it can be settled tomorrow, and then they can be sent to the hotel room Fu Xinlian assigned them.
Seeing that Fu Xinlian explained everything to the people on the side in a blink of an eye, Bai Yue was very satisfied with the efficiency. On the way, she kept praising Brother Guangxin for being very capable! Very efficient!
Hearing the clerk on the side look at her boss very strangely, Fu Xinlian secretly complained in her heart, wishing to send this little ancestor back to the hotel as soon as possible.
Three days later, Bai Yue and his wife, who were having dinner in the hotel, received an invitation from Ruiyun Auction House sent by Fu Xinlian's police.
During the past three days, Bai Yue also found out about the energy and status of this heartless brother through different channels.
It is said that he is the proud disciple of Mo Kaiji, the director of the Beijing Museum, and the eldest son of the third generation of the Fu family, the largest wealthy family in the capital. He is likely to inherit the family business in the future and become the diamond king that many ladies are competing for.
I also heard that Mr. Fu was particularly fond of ancient Chinese history and culture, especially antiques, calligraphy and paintings. He tied his hair in hairpins, burned incense and ate vegetarian food.
